title: Improved self-powered perovskite CH3NH3PbI3/SnO2 heterojunction photodetectors achieved by interfacial engineering with a synergic effect
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2749-2757
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08892A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Guipeng Li, Huimin Zhang, Weihao Qin, Mingming Chen
Interfacial engineering with a spin-coating of a thin SnO2 layer has been demonstrated to suppress interfacial non-radiative recombination and enhance carrier transport at the CH3NH3PbI3/SnO2 interface.
